{{Top|leg}}
'''Vertag crystal''' was a rare form of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. The three land masses of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar]] were composed of Vertag crystals that grew in spires that were [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall. At night, they glowed with a faint blue light. The wind blowing through the crystal spires at high altitudes resulted in a beautiful and soothing harmonic wave that was known as the [[Shownar Lullaby]].
